**Date**: 2026-06-10
**Author**: gen-physicist (generated by /rclab-plan per-wave swarm)

## Wave 6 Summary

This wave clears two of the eight no-motion-through-S104 STAGE-1-CANDIDATE joint cross-axis theorems that sit in the `open-channel-ledger.md §C` cohort ("the clearest 'ready to execute' queue in the framework"). No working-paper carry-forward surfaces these — they are REGISTER-SOURCED (1c-REGISTERS CONSUME), the WP-only blind spot this step exists to close. Two are admitted this session by load-bearing-ness + age: **K1 §VII.U.2** (the parse-tree 4-corner-classification PARENT theorem that the MANDATORY-K=3 `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Algebra-axis orthogonality K-counter"` rule and `registry-landing.md §"Operator-Projection Reading-A Naming Hygiene"` rule are BUILT ON), and **K4 §VII.AG.1** (the oldest unverified cross-pillar candidate, LANDED S87 W6-1, Pillar VII↔V cyclic-fold isomorphism at 0.0095% residual). The remaining six (K2, K3, K7, K8, K9, K11) stay in the ledger queue (capacity).

Both gates are **Stage-2 two-agent parallel cross-axis verifies** per `.claude/rules/joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"`: TWO cross-reviewers on DIFFERENT axes, dispatched IN PARALLEL, operating WITHOUT prior workshop context (registered Stage-1 entry text + cited input files ONLY — NO workshop transcripts in dispatch prompts), with the original Stage-0 authoring agents EXCLUDED (including the downstream-inheritance reach test, condition 2b). JOINT clauses are PASS-AND'd across both verdicts (logical AND, not OR). PASS ⇒ STAGE-3-PERMANENT; any clause FAIL ⇒ stays STAGE-1 + remediation CF; any clause INFO ⇒ Stage-2-INFO-deferred. Audit `computations/_shared/_joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py` items (1)-(6) are checked at plan-freeze, including item-6 (cross-reviewer audit-machinery self-citation check) and the `--check-reviewers SLOT --reviewers A,B` Stage-0-authorship exclusion sub-check (S100a hardening).

These verifies are STRUCTURAL VALIDATION gates (NON-PHONONIC: the methodology-floor F-image per `epistemic-discipline.md §"Layer-Decomposition"` of the substrate-IS theorem they validate). They re-confirm an ALREADY-REGISTERED structural theorem from first principles — they do NOT re-derive it via the originating workshop's path, and they do NOT edit the registry. The STAGE-3-PERMANENT tag-flip (on PASS) is an orchestrator session-end-synthesis action + ledger §C row update, NOT a wave-6 write.

## Wave 6 Decision Point Prerequisites

Neither wave-6 gate consumes a prior-wave (S105 W1–W5) output. Both consume ONLY the already-landed `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md` Stage-1 entries (frozen at S88 / S87 respectively) + the pre-registered Stage-2 dispatch pools + the audit script. There is no intra-session upstream verdict gating wave 6; it is dispatchable from session start, in parallel with all other waves.

The ONE structural precondition is plan-freeze-time (not runtime): the reviewer-pair selection MUST clear the `_joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py --check-reviewers` Stage-0-authorship exclusion. This is satisfied BY CONSTRUCTION below (each gate pins a reviewer pair drawn from the verified pools with the EXCLUSION set named + its registry-line provenance). If at dispatch a selected reviewer fires the downstream-inheritance reach test (condition 2b — e.g. a `reference_*.md` memory citing the originating workshop transcript as canonical), the orchestrator re-selects the next pool member and re-runs the exclusion check before dispatch; the closeout gate honestly closes per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` if no admissible pool member remains (it does not, here — both pools have ≥1 admissible member per gate).

# (7) substitution_chain — the PASS-AND aggregation + scope-fence direction claim
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "PASS of S105-VIIU2-STAGE2-VERIFY promotes the PARENT §VII.U.2 four-corner theorem
            (NOT the already-permanent Var_a SUB-row) to STAGE-3-PERMANENT, and a FAIL on ANY
            audited PARENT clause keeps it at STAGE-1."

    Step 1 (Definition — Stage-2 PASS, joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"):
      Stage2_PASS := [ BOTH cross-reviewers PASS their single-axis clauses ]
                  AND [ EVERY JOINT clause PASS independently in BOTH verdicts (logical AND) ].
    Step 2 (Definition — PARENT clause partition, registered entry registry ~line 13030–13119):
      single_axis(A) = {(a) INVARIANT family, (b) DEPENDENT family}   [both algebra-axis-side; vdd audits]
      JOINT          = {(c) orthogonality, (d) 4-corner partition, (e) convergence}.
      (The Var_a SUB-row clauses (a)-(f) at registry ~line 13104 are EXCLUDED — STAGE-3-PERMANENT S92 W4-7.)
    Step 3 (Substitute the partition into Stage2_PASS, no simplification):
      Stage2_PASS = [ AxisA(a)=PASS ∧ AxisA(b)=PASS ]
                 ∧ [ AxisA(c)=PASS ∧ AxisB(c)=PASS ]
                 ∧ [ AxisA(d)=PASS ∧ AxisB(d)=PASS ]
                 ∧ [ AxisA(e)=PASS ∧ AxisB(e)=PASS ].
    Step 4 (Simplify — collapse to composite per gate-verdicts.md composite rule):
      composite = FAIL   if any conjunct's clause-verdict == FAIL          (one FAILing clause breaks the AND)
                = INFO   elif any conjunct's clause-verdict == INFO         (no FAIL; an INFO defers)
                = PASS   else (every conjunct PASS).
    Step 5 (Direction — read off from the canonical form):
      composite == PASS  ⇒  Stage2_PASS == True  ⇒  the PARENT theorem qualifies for STAGE-3-PERMANENT;
      composite == FAIL  ⇒  ∃ a PARENT clause that FAILed  ⇒  PARENT stays STAGE-1, that clause routes to a
                            remediation CF (the AND is monotone: removing a PASS conjunct cannot raise the composite);
      composite == INFO  ⇒  ∃ a PARENT clause at INFO (no FAIL)  ⇒  Stage-2-INFO-deferred, PARENT stays STAGE-1.
    Conclusion: the promotion direction is monotone in the per-clause verdicts; PASS is reachable ONLY by
                the full all-PASS conjunction over the PARENT partition, and the Var_a SUB-row's prior
                STAGE-3-PERMANENT status is independent of (does not pre-determine) the PARENT outcome.
      [SCOPE NOTE: this is a logical-aggregation direction claim, not a substrate-physics sign/threshold
       claim; the substitution chain documents the PASS-AND monotonicity + scope fence per math-scripts.md.]

PASS_meaning: >

  (single-axis (a),(b) + JOINT (c),(d),(e) PASS-AND'd) ⇒ qualifies for STAGE-3-PERMANENT. Solution-space

  are BUILT ON is now independently-verified structural infrastructure, not a candidate. The framework's
  parse-tree corner-classification machinery gains a permanently-validated foundation.
FAIL_meaning: >
  ≥1 PARENT clause FAILs a first-principles blind audit ⇒ PARENT stays STAGE-1; the FAILing clause routes
  to a next-session remediation CF (4-field spec naming the clause + the axis whose reviewer FAILed it).
  Solution-space reading: the corner-classification infrastructure has a structural gap at the named clause;
  downstream MANDATORY-K=3 rules that cite the PARENT remain CONDITIONAL on the gap's resolution (the SUB-row's
  STAGE-3-PERMANENT status is unaffected — it was independently promoted at S92 W4-7).
INFO_meaning: >
  ≥1 PARENT clause returns INFO (no FAIL) in either verdict ⇒ Stage-2-INFO-deferred; PARENT stays STAGE-1
  with the INFO clause documented as a Stage-2-INFO-deferred item (joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"
  INFO criterion). Solution-space reading: the clause is neither confirmed nor refuted at this verify; a
  sharper re-dispatch (or a refined input pin) is the forward path. This is the registry-state encoding for
  the not-yet-fourth-token HELD outcomes (per r3-yaml template verdict-rubric note).

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:

substrate_framing: |
  NON-PHONONIC (methodology). The substrate-physics CONTENT being validated is GEOMETRIC: the functional-family
  decomposition of (A_K, H_K, D_K) into algebra-INVARIANT spectrum-only functionals F_inv({λ_k, m_k}) = Σ_k m_k g(λ_k)
  (Seeley-DeWitt moments a_n^{regulator}, ζ-residues, Mellin-Dirichlet identities — properties of D_K's spectrum
  alone) versus algebra-DEPENDENT state-pair functionals F_dep(ω_1,ω_2;A) = ‖[D,π(A)]‖_op (Connes distances —
  properties of the algebra A together with D's commutator action). The direction of explanation flows FROM the
  substrate: D_K eigenvalues + the algebra A_K = ℂ ⊕ ℍ ⊕ M_3(ℂ) → the two structurally-orthogonal functional
  families → the 4-corner partition cells {I,II,III,IV} over Mellin poles s∈{3,4} → the observable classification
  every downstream §VII entry consumes. The GATE itself is the methodology-floor F-image (epistemic-discipline.md
  §"Layer-Decomposition" Phi correspondence): a numerical-PASS-predicate at the substrate layer maps to an
  artifact-existence-and-cross-axis-agreement predicate at the audit layer. This gate does NOT re-derive the
  substrate physics; it records the substrate's OWN structural validation under two independent cross-axis
  reviewers operating without prior workshop context — the constructive-independent-agreement pathway of
  joint-theorem-promotion.md, NOT shared-context agreement (which is non-evidential per epistemic-discipline.md).

method:

    cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md 5-anatomy + 3-level discipline (MANDATORY at K=3) at their verdict layer.

    envelope) + the SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE-CO-PRIMARY ANCHOR-1 + the quotient-functor rank-match (T1-T3).
    Axis-B reviewer (superfluid-universe / substrate-physics axis = ANCHOR-2/C side: Pillar-V
    Josephson-array dual-hex realization) audits anatomy elements 2 (laboratory-IN S67) + 5 (Level-3

    criterion. STEP 2 — gen-physicist PASS-AND closeout: load both reviewer JSONs, compute the per-clause
    AND aggregate, determine the composite, emit ONE verdict line via emit_verdict.
  producing_script: "computations/session-105/s105_w6_viiag1_stage2_passand_closeout.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator — the mathematical comparison form
operator:
  type: "set"                              # logical-AND aggregation over per-clause/per-element verdicts + the cross-pillar 5-anatomy/3-level checks
  form: >
    composite_PASS  iff  ( AxisA_verdict(e) == PASS  for every anatomy/anchor element e audited on Axis-A )
                     AND ( AxisB_verdict(e) == PASS  for every anatomy/anchor element e audited on Axis-B )
                     AND ( JOINT_element(j) == PASS in BOTH AxisA AND AxisB  for every JOINT element j )
                     AND ( Level3 < Level2 confirmed in BOTH verdicts )       # 0.0095% < 0.10% registry-PASS criterion
                     AND ( all 5 IS-not-IN anatomy elements present + bridge map explicitly named [HKR/Connes-Karoubi, NOT "analogous"] + Level-2 sub-class declared binding )
    where Axis-A elements = {anatomy 1,3,4 ; ANCHOR-1 ; quotient T1-T3}, Axis-B elements = {anatomy 2,5 ; ANCHOR-2 ; cokernel decl},
    JOINT elements = {Level-1 cohomology-class identity, element-3 bridge-map composition, T1 quotient-equivalence}.
    composite_FAIL  iff  any audited element == FAIL in either verdict, OR Level3 ≥ Level2, OR a 5-anatomy element is absent / bridge map not explicitly named / Level-2 declared non-binding.
    composite_INFO  iff  (no FAIL) AND (any audited element == INFO in either verdict).

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary — exact threshold value + direction
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: >
    Logical conjunction: BOTH reviewers PASS their axis-side anatomy/anchor elements, JOINT elements PASS-AND'd
    across both axes, AND the registry-PASS criterion Level-3 < Level-2 (0.0095% < 0.10%) RE-CONFIRMED in both
    verdicts, AND the cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy MANDATORY-K=3 structural checks (5 anatomy elements present +
    bridge map explicitly named + Level-2 binding sub-class) all pass. The ONLY numerical conjunct is the
    Level-3 < Level-2 inequality (Sage-exact: 0.0009474440 < 0.001000000, ratio 0.094744, 10.55× inside).
  direction: "<"                            # the numerical conjunct: Level-3 (0.0009474 frac) < Level-2 (0.001 envelope); the rest is logical-AND equality to the all-PASS conjunction

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically — is the threshold analytically derived?
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    The Level-3 < Level-2 numerical conjunct is analytically pinned: Level-2 = L^{-3} at d=4, L_max=10 ⇒ 10^{-3}
    = 0.10% (inherited from §VII.AF.1, registry ~line 14731); Level-3 = |r_HP1 − k_link×(1−δ_SDW)|/r_HP1 with
    r_HP1 = 2.0/1.031, k_link = 6/3, δ_SDW = 1−0.970024 ⇒ Sage-QQ-exact 0.0009474440 (verified this plan-freeze:
    0.00947% < 0.10%, ratio 0.0947). The logical-AND aggregation conjuncts are categorical (no analytic scalar).

# (4) reachable_rationals — does the admissible region contain a rational mesh?
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: >
    The Level-3 value is an EXACT rational (Sage QQ: residual_abs = 0.0001837904947, Level-3 = 0.00009474440000);
    the verdict-token aggregation space is discrete-categorical. mesh: the single numerical conjunct sits at one
    exact rational point well inside the envelope; reason: exact-rational-anchor.

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  # --- Stage-2 reviewer PAIR (one per axis; CONFIRMED against the registered Stage-0 authorship) ---
  reviewer_axis_A: "connes-ncg-theorist"             # spectral-functional axis = ANCHOR-1/V side (Mellin-Strip / heat-kernel residue duality, registry §VII.T). PRE-REGISTERED in the §VII.AG.1 promotion-path block (registry ~line 14769: "connes-ncg-theorist audits the spectral-functional-axis clauses 1, 3 + JOINT clauses"). connes is NOT a §VII.AG.1 author (the authoring pair is lizzi + volovik = CF-LZ-VV) ⇒ ADMISSIBLE.
  reviewer_axis_B: "transit-dynamics-theorist"       # substrate-physics axis = ANCHOR-2/C side (Pillar-V Josephson-array dual-hex realization), distinct from the spectral-functional axis. PRE-REGISTERED substitute (registry ~line 14769: "volovik is co-author and ineligible … substitute alt-axis cross-reviewer = transit-dynamics-theorist OR mack-cosmic-bridge"). transit-dynamics-theorist chosen over mack (mack is the registry sole-writer → conservatively a Stage-0 author per _joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py extract_stage0_authors).
  # --- EXCLUSION SET (CONFIRMED against the registered Stage-0 authorship lines + provenance) ---
  excluded_reviewers: "{lizzi-spectral-functional-theorist, volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist}"   # CONFIRMED at registry ~line 14702 ("Joint authorship tag: CF-LZ-VV-S86 (lizzi-spectral-functional-theorist + volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist; 3-round workshop convergence at R3 lock)") AND the ANCHOR-1/V = lizzi (line 14708) + ANCHOR-2/C = volovik (line 14709) attribution lines AND the promotion-path block (line 14769: "volovik is co-author and ineligible"). PLUS mack-cosmic-bridge EXCLUDED conservatively (registry-row writer = Stage-0 author per the audit's extract_stage0_authors over-exclusion design). connes (Axis-A) and transit-dynamics-theorist (Axis-B) are both clean of §VII.AG.1 authorship — VERIFIED.
  # --- plan-freeze exclusion-check command (S100a hardening; MUST run before dispatch) ---
  exclusion_check_command: "python computations/_shared/_joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py --check-reviewers VII.AG.1 --reviewers connes-ncg-theorist,transit-dynamics-theorist --strict   # expect EXCLUSION-PASS (neither reviewer is a registered Stage-0 author of §VII.AG.1)"
  # --- CLAUSE / ELEMENT PARTITION (enumerated from the registered entry, registry ~line 14704–14741) ---
  clause_partition_axis_A: "{IS-not-IN element 1 (substrate-IS T7, line 14725), element 3 (bridge map HKR∘Connes-Karoubi, line 14729), element 4 (L^{-3} algebraic envelope, line 14731); SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE ANCHOR-1 (V; Mellin-Strip residue duality, line 14708); quotient-functor T1-T3 rank-match (line 14715–14721)}"   # Axis-A = spectral-functional / V-side; connes audits
  clause_partition_axis_B: "{IS-not-IN element 2 (laboratory-IN S67, line 14727), element 5 (Level-3 empirical anchor 0.0095%, line 14733); SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE ANCHOR-2 (C; Pillar-V dual-hex Josephson realization, line 14709); residual-cokernel-content declaration (T3, line 14721)}"   # Axis-B = superfluid-universe / substrate-physics / C-side; transit-dynamics-theorist audits
  clause_partition_JOINT: "{Level-1 cohomology-class identity [T7]≅[S67] (regulator-invariant + L-independent, line 14737); element-3 bridge-map COMPOSITION through the cyclic-fold quotient (the two anchors are non-fungible — line 14711); T1 quotient-equivalence specification (cyclic-fold pairing on the 6-conjunct lattice, line 14715)}"   # JOINT: require PASS-AND across BOTH axes (the bridge is a SEQUENTIAL V→C chain per SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE-CO-PRIMARY; neither anchor alone closes the conclusion — line 14706)
  # --- cross-pillar MANDATORY-K=3 structural checks (cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md) ---
  cross_pillar_checks: "Both reviewers verify at their verdict layer: (i) all 5 IS-not-IN anatomy elements PRESENT; (ii) all 3 level markers PRESENT with explicit values; (iii) Level-3 < Level-2 at canonical L_max (0.0095% < 0.10%); (iv) bridge map EXPLICITLY NAMED (HKR / Connes-Karoubi pairing — NOT 'analogous'/'corresponds to'); (v) Level-2 envelope sub-class declared (binding — the L^{-3} HKR-image BINDS Level-1 via the Mellin-Strip residue duality, registry §VII.T) per cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §'Audit at plan-freeze' items 1-7. Item (v) binding-declaration: the registered entry's Level-2 (line 14739) cites the §VII.AF.1 L^{-3} HKR envelope (binding); the reviewers confirm the binding citation is explicit."
  # --- PASS-AND logic ---
  passand_logic: "JOINT elements (Level-1 identity, bridge-map composition, T1 quotient-equivalence) PASS iff BOTH reviewer JSONs return PASS on that element (logical AND); axis-side elements PASS iff the owning-axis reviewer returns PASS; the Level-3 < Level-2 conjunct must be RE-CONFIRMED in BOTH verdicts; composite collapses to FAIL on any element FAIL or Level3≥Level2 or a 5-anatomy/bridge-map/binding structural-check failure, INFO on any element INFO (no FAIL), else PASS"
  # --- substrate-input-orthogonality declaration ---
  substrate_input_orthogonality: >
    Axis-A reviewer loads the §VII.T Mellin-Strip / Convergence-Cone anchor + the §VII.AF.1 L^{-3}
    envelope calibration-corpus row (the V-side spectral-functional inputs) to audit elements 1,3,4 + ANCHOR-1
    + T1-T3. Axis-B reviewer loads the S67 Frustration-Triangle proven_1738 Pillar-V theorem + the workshop
    quantitative-anchor block re-derivation inputs (the C-side superfluid-universe / Josephson-array inputs)
    to audit elements 2,5 + ANCHOR-2 + cokernel. ORTHOGONALITY: the §VII.T spectral-functional anchor is loaded
    by EXACTLY ONE reviewer (Axis-A); the S67 proven_1738 Pillar-V theorem is loaded by EXACTLY ONE reviewer
    (Axis-B) — the substrate-input-orthogonality predicate is SATISFIED. CAVEAT: the SHARED numerical anchor is
    the T6 number-pair (L_loose=2.0, L_strict=1.031) underlying r_HP1; BOTH reviewers re-confirm Level-3 < Level-2
    from this shared T6 anchor (the registry-PASS criterion conjunct), so a substrate-input-OVERLAP caveat applies
    on the Level-3-recomputation sub-axis — tagged explicitly per joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Substrate-input-
    orthogonality clause" (Stage-2 PASS-AND establishes structural-output-type independence on the SHARED Level-3
    input; the axis-side anatomy/anchor elements 1-5 ARE orthogonal-input). The overlap is recorded, NOT a FAIL.
  # --- blind-dispatch condition ---
  blind_dispatch: "Each reviewer receives ONLY: the registered §VII.AG.1 Stage-1 entry text (registry block ~line 14692–14786) + the cited input files. NO workshop transcript (s86-two-layer-obstruction-s67-frustration.md, 245 KB), NO this plan-block text. Reviewers verify the bridge theorem from first principles (re-confirm the SOURCE-DOUBLE-CITE-CO-PRIMARY chain V→A_F→C→conclusion, the 5-anatomy, the 3-level ladder, the quotient-functor rank-match, and Level-3 < Level-2), NOT via the workshop derivation path."
  # --- generic R3 machinery keys ---
  N_eval: "2"                               # two parallel reviewer dispatches

  step_size: "N/A — deterministic aggregation"
  tolerance: "N/A — categorical verdict-token comparison for the aggregation; the ONE numerical conjunct (Level-3 < Level-2) is a STRICT inequality with exact-rational operands (no float tolerance needed; Sage QQ exact)"
  scheme: "joint-theorem-stage-2-cross-axis-verify"
  convention: "vii-ag-1-stage-1-candidate-to-stage-3-promotion-cross-axis-PASS-AND-poleconv-A-double"   # poleconv tag: the bridge's Mellin pole is substrate-distance-1 s=3 under the double-power convention ζ_{D_K}(s)=Σ m_k λ_k^{-2s} (registry ~line 14718, 14729) per regulator-pin-discipline.md §"Mellin Pole-Set Labeling"; (pole_in_s=3, curvature_grade_n=2) on the SU(3) dimension spectrum

# (6) audit_discriminators — which inputs feed audit_sha256 vs content_sha256
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "registered_VII_AG_1_entry_text", "reviewer_axis_A_verdict_json", "reviewer_axis_B_verdict_json", "level3_level2_exact_rationals", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — the PASS-AND aggregation + the Level-3<Level-2 registry-PASS direction
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "PASS of S105-VIIAG1-STAGE2-VERIFY promotes §VII.AG.1 to STAGE-3-PERMANENT; PASS requires BOTH
            the cross-axis clause PASS-AND AND the registry-PASS inequality Level-3 < Level-2 RE-CONFIRMED."

    Step 1 (Definition — registry-PASS criterion, cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Registry-PASS criterion"):
      registry_PASS := [ Level-3 empirical value < Level-2 envelope value at canonical L_max ]
                    AND [ Level-2 declared binding ].
    Step 2 (Definition — the operands, registered entry registry ~line 14731, 14733, 14741):
      Level-2 := L^{-3} at d=4, L_max=10               = 10^{-3} = 0.001 (frac) = 0.10%.
      Level-3 := |r_HP1 − k_link_ratio·(1−δ_SDW)| / r_HP1,
                 r_HP1 = 2.0/1.031,  k_link_ratio = 6/3 = 2,  δ_SDW = 1 − 0.970024.
    Step 3 (Substitute, no simplification — exact QQ, verified this plan-freeze via Sage):
      r_HP1          = (20/10)/(1031/1000)              = 1.939864210
      predicted      = 2·(1 − (1 − 970024/1000000))     = 2·(970024/1000000) = 1.940048000
      residual_abs   = |1.939864210 − 1.940048000|      = 0.0001837904947
      Level-3        = 0.0001837904947 / 1.939864210    = 0.00009474440000 (frac) = 0.00947440%.
    Step 4 (Simplify the inequality to canonical form):
      Level-3 / Level-2 = 0.00009474440000 / 0.001000000 = 0.0947440.
    Step 5 (Direction — read off the canonical form):
      0.0947440 < 1   ⇔   Level-3 < Level-2   ⇒   registry-PASS inequality SATISFIED (10.55× inside the envelope).
      The Stage-2 composite PASS additionally requires the cross-axis PASS-AND:
        composite = FAIL  if any audited anatomy/anchor element == FAIL  OR  Level-3 ≥ Level-2  OR  a 5-anatomy /
                          bridge-map-naming / Level-2-binding structural check fails;
                  = INFO  elif any audited element == INFO (no FAIL);
                  = PASS  else (every element PASS in its axis AND JOINT elements PASS-AND'd AND Level-3 < Level-2).
    Conclusion: PASS ⇒ §VII.AG.1 → STAGE-3-PERMANENT (the SECOND registered cross-pillar bridge gains
                blind-cross-axis-verified permanence); FAIL ⇒ stays STAGE-1, the FAILing element (or a
                Level-3 ≥ Level-2 regression, or a structural-anatomy gap) routes to a remediation CF;
                INFO ⇒ Stage-2-INFO-deferred. The numerical conjunct is mnemonic-free (exact QQ per
                math-scripts.md §"Mnemonic-vs-exact ratio discipline").

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  §VII.AG.1 T7↔S67 cyclic-fold quotient-isomorphism survives blind two-agent cross-axis verify on ALL anatomy/
  anchor elements (PASS-AND on the JOINT Level-1 identity + bridge-map composition + T1 quotient-equivalence) AND
  re-confirms Level-3 < Level-2 (0.0095% < 0.10%) in both verdicts AND clears the cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy
  MANDATORY-K=3 structural checks ⇒ qualifies for STAGE-3-PERMANENT. Solution-space reading: the framework's
  OLDEST unverified cross-pillar bridge (Pillar VII↔V, the SECOND registered) becomes blind-cross-axis-verified
  permanent structural infrastructure — the dual-hex plaquette-cycle = single substrate observable (T6 amplitude /
  T7 count / S67 half-quantum frustration) reading is independently confirmed.
FAIL_meaning: >
  ≥1 anatomy/anchor element FAILs a first-principles blind audit, OR Level-3 ≥ Level-2 (a registry-PASS-criterion
  regression), OR a MANDATORY-K=3 structural check fails (a 5-anatomy element absent / bridge map not explicitly
  named / Level-2 declared non-binding) ⇒ §VII.AG.1 stays STAGE-1; the FAILing element routes to a next-session
  remediation CF (4-field spec naming the element + the axis whose reviewer FAILed it). Solution-space reading: the
  cross-pillar bridge has a structural gap at the named element; the T7≅S67 quotient-isomorphism remains a candidate.
INFO_meaning: >
  ≥1 anatomy/anchor element returns INFO (no FAIL) in either verdict ⇒ Stage-2-INFO-deferred; §VII.AG.1 stays
  STAGE-1 with the INFO element documented (joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2" INFO criterion). Solution-space
  reading: the element is neither confirmed nor refuted at this verify; a sharper re-dispatch is the forward path.

  substrate-IS observable (Pillar-VII T7 — the Two-Layer Obstruction categorical-NULL functor on the Jensen-deformed
